program: APPUI-01 - Detailed functional studies inside frozen Phase-1 architecture
question: Can truth/knowledge/disclosure inspection support creator-global and Character-bounded views, provenance and uncertainty capacity, and exact return behavior without leaking hidden material or freezing a final epistemic taxonomy/storage model?
inherited_law: Character-bounded disclosure must never leak creator-global information.
Truth status and temporal status remain independently represented.
Unknown, false, absent and withheld/private are not interchangeable.
Fact, claim, belief, suspicion, memory, provenance and uncertainty may be capacity witnesses only where Product authority supports them.
Deep inspection is contextual capacity rather than permanent ontology navigation.
Light and Dark preserve one semantic system; no Phase-2 Stage successor is created.

design_result.creator_global_role: May expose Product-supported truth/claim/knowledge/provenance distinctions for creator inspection without defining a final data model.
design_result.character_bounded_role: Presents only Product-supported Character-visible material; material outside the boundary is not enumerated, counted, summarized or hinted by default.
design_result.disclosure_switch_rule: Changing disclosure changes visibility, not persistent Character identity or underlying Product-supported Production state.
design_result.taxonomy_rule: Witnesses prove inspection capacity only and do not freeze exhaustive Product entity types, storage schema or inference policy.
design_result.depth_rule: Source, belief, memory or uncertainty detail may deepen only within the active disclosure boundary.
design_result.return_rule: Close/Back restores the exact creator-global semantic origin and focus; no knowledge transfer or Production mutation is implied.
design_result.theme_parity: PASS - Light/Dark preserve identical records, disclosure boundary and state meaning
design_result.responsive_rule: wide adjacency -> medium overlay/substitution -> narrow sequential surfaces; disclosure strength and exact return remain invariant

mechanical_preflight.environment: Microsoft Edge Chromium CDP; exact self-contained HTML; no external resources

first_visual_pass_findings: One section-law sentence used the phrase 'creator-global truth store', which implied a concrete storage/data-model architecture outside this study's authority.
corrections: Replaced 'creator-global truth store' with 'underlying Product-supported Production state' and reran all viewport and forced-colors checks.

non_authority: Exact epistemic entity types, fields, truth authority, confidence semantics, inference policy and storage model remain Product-defined.
Exact knowledge transfer, discovery, forgetting, deception, contradiction resolution and consequence semantics remain open.
Exact Scene lifecycle, Perspective switching, Take/Rehearsal/branching, transcript/timer/Pause, provider/model/cost and Performer assignment remain open.
Final typography, palette, materials, icons, diagrams, motion and native WinUI behavior remain open.
No Stage visual successor, runtime/package/Store authority or native accessibility-device proof is created.
approval: APPROVED BY STANDING DIRECTOR DELEGATION - CLEAN RECURSIVE AUDIT
next: Detail persistence/recovery status inside the frozen shell: healthy persistence remains quiet; interruption/recovery remains truthful application state outside fiction; exact prior task, semantic origin and focus restore without inventing Character behavior.
